site.tagline: Web flasher and codeplug editor (CPS) for the Baofeng DM-32UV running the Open25-DM32 firmware (P25 / NXDN).
home.title: Open25-DM32 (P25 / NXDN)
home.headline: DM32 Web CPS & Flasher
home.lead: Install the Open25-DM32 firmware with P25 and NXDN on your Baofeng DM-32UV and edit its codeplug in the browser. Nothing is uploaded to any server: the radio, the backups and your files stay on your computer.
home.browser: Needs Chrome or Edge on a desktop computer (Web Serial) and the radio's programming cable.
home.f_flash_text: Back up, install, update and restore the firmware over the programming cable.
home.f_editor_text: FM, AM, DMR, P25, NXDN and P25 trunking channels, AES-256 keys, zones, contacts and the ID database: read and write the radio or save files.
home.experimental_text: Experimental firmware: the new base boots on the radio, but its P25/NXDN voice, AES encryption and APRS are not tested on air yet. Always keep the backup the flasher offers. Use it at your own risk, on frequencies you are licensed for.
home.update_mode_1: Switch the radio off and connect the programming cable to the computer.
home.update_mode_2: Hold PTT and SK1 while you switch the radio on.
home.update_mode_3: A green LED means the radio is in update mode.
home.update_mode_note: The flasher tells you what to do with the radio at each step. Usually switching it off and on when asked is enough; update mode is the factory loader's fallback route.
home.codec_title: The AMBE codec is not on this site
home.codec_text: This site only hosts the firmware image without the AMBE codec (proprietary to DVSI). The flasher takes the codec from your radio's memory (read during the backup) or from the original Baofeng firmware file you pick, and merges it with the image inside the browser. The codec is never uploaded to any server or distributed here.

flash.lead: Install, back up and restore the Baofeng DM-32UV's firmware over the programming cable. Needs Chrome or Edge on a desktop computer.
flash.beta.title: Open25-DM32 P25/NXDN Is Experimental
flash.beta.lead: This is RadioFoundry's flasher, adapted to install the image of the Open25-DM32 derivative with P25 and NXDN on the DM-32UV. P25 and NXDN voice worked both ways with the earlier base; this image, on the current RadioFoundry base, boots on the radio but is not tested on air yet.
flash.beta.risk_features: Experimental build: some features (APRS, P25 trunking) are not tested on air and may not work.
flash.beta.help_text: If a step fails, download the report the page offers and open an issue on the firmware repository describing what happened.
flash.fw.title: Firmware to Install
flash.fw.lead: This site installs one prebuilt Open25-DM32 image with P25 and NXDN (no feature choice). It is downloaded from this same site and checked against its manifest (size and SHA-256) before anything is written.
flash.fw.codec: The image has no AMBE codec: the next steps take it from your radio or from the original firmware file you pick, and merge it here, in the browser.
flash.fw.unavailable: Could not load the firmware from this site: {error}
flash.fw.self_text: You can also install your own DM-32 build: pick rfoundry_dm32.bin (the image without the codec) and, if you have it, its manifest from tools/release.py.
flash.task.install.text: Install Open25-DM32 (P25/NXDN) on a DM-32UV running its original firmware or RadioFoundry.
flash.task.update.text: Install this site's image on a DM-32UV that already runs RadioFoundry or Open25-DM32. Its channels and calibration stay. Since 2026-11-17 the image is built on current RadioFoundry: it no longer has DMR AES, P25 Phase 2 or P25 trunking TX, and AES keys live in the codeplug keyring: load them again in the editor (Radio tab) after updating.
editor.sim: Simulation: Read from Radio and Write to Radio use a simulated DM-32UV.

flash.c7.done.ready: Open25-DM32 is running. FM, P25, DMR and NXDN voice are available.
flash.done.ready: Open25-DM32 is running and P25, DMR and NXDN voice are available.
flash.c7.done.no_codec: The firmware is running without the AMBE codec: FM and P25 work, DMR and NXDN voice do not. Reinstall with a codec.
flash.done.no_codec: The radio has no AMBE codec, so DMR and NXDN voice are not available; FM and P25 work. Go back to the codec step and use the codec from your stock firmware file.
flash.now.codec_none: Missing (no DMR or NXDN voice; P25 works)
flash.codec.lead: DMR and NXDN voice require the radio manufacturer's AMBE codec; P25 uses its own IMBE vocoder and does not need it. The codec is not part of RadioFoundry; it remains in the radio or is taken from your stock firmware file.
flash.codec.risk.no_voice: DMR and NXDN voice are not available (FM and P25 work) until the radio is reinstalled with your stock file.
flash.codec.risk.other_version: If the radio runs a different version, DMR and NXDN voice are not available (FM and P25 work) until the radio is reinstalled with your stock file.
flash.codec.risk.maybe_no_voice: If the radio has no codec, DMR and NXDN voice are not available (FM and P25 work) until the radio is reinstalled with your stock file.
flash.codec.keep_none.title: DMR and NXDN Voice Will Not Work
flash.c7.codec.none: None (FM and P25; no DMR or NXDN voice)
flash.c7.codec.action: DMR and NXDN voice require the radio's own codec (P25 works without it)
flash.c7.codec.without: Install without the codec (FM and P25; the codec can be added later)
flash.c7.codec.none_title: This Installation Will Not Include the AMBE Codec (DMR and NXDN Voice)
flash.nocodec.title: Install Without DMR and NXDN Voice?
flash.nocodec.text: This installation does not include the AMBE codec. The radio will not be able to send or receive DMR or NXDN voice. Analog FM and P25 will work.
flash.help.s.novoice: DMR or NXDN voice does not work
